purpose: Select an open-source reproducible per-object 3DGS pipeline for 10 filtered Objaverse assets
runtime_validation_status: passed: ACP H100; 2000 steps; 4 held-out views; checkpoint, PLY and 96-frame RGB GIF verified
reproduction_scope: Installation, one known-pose object, training, held-out evaluation and rendering. Not a reproduction of paper benchmark metrics or end-to-end SfM.

candidates.reason: 官方训练、评估、轨迹视频、PLY和benchmark脚本齐全，适合Python批处理和消融。v1.6.0是尚未正式发布的main进展。
3DGUT/3DGRT官方实现，有synthetic/COLMAP配置与论文benchmark；复杂相机优势并非当前针孔物体任务所必需。
跨平台无GUI训练与评估，Rust Cargo.lock；独立轨迹视频/GIF仍需补适配。
维护活跃且功能完整，Linux源码构建要求CUDA12.8+/GCC14+/CMake3.30+/vcpkg，集成成本高。
Splatfacto处理、训练、评估、路径渲染CLI完整，但依赖更多；正式版本固定gsplat1.4.0。
原作者基线及评价材料完整，但默认环境较旧，许可证为自定义研究用途许可。

gsplat_v153_integration_notes: Use exact legacy rmbrualla/pycolmap Git dependency; official modern pycolmap has a different API.
RGBA inputs must be explicitly composited to RGB; loader slices off alpha. Use black background for default trainer.
Set data_factor=1 for the existing 256x256 images.
Keep held-out views fixed. Default test_every=8 yields four held-out views for thirty sorted images.
Input parser expects COLMAP cameras/images/points3D; existing poses.npy requires convention and format conversion.
--ckpt performs evaluation/rendering only, not training resume.
Example trajectory video concatenates color and depth; task GIF requires RGB-only output and suitable object orbit.
Pin Python packages after successful runtime validation; upstream requirements are not a complete lockfile.
